description: Ordinary-client half of the B-1064 reconnect proof. It proves initial gameplay, waits for endpoint-scoped retry authority after real teardown, invokes the production reconnect API once, then proves a second live gameplay epoch.

input_sequence.comment: Initial gameplay must be usable before timeout.
Wait through production disconnect and lobby return; no raw endpoint is supplied by this fixture.
Invoke exactly one endpoint-scoped production retry.
Require a second stage-live epoch after stable-slot restore.
The restored player must regain continuously usable gameplay.
